prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Production bitmap animation atlas for a grounded, realistic, detailed side-view war game. Generate exactly ONE brand-new square raster image with a genuinely transparent alpha background.

Subject and animation: ONE isolated GRAY POWDER / GUN-SMOKE cloud evolving across exactly 16 hand-painted cels. The SAME cloud expands, rolls, becomes wispy, and thins over time; these are consecutive animation frames, not 16 separately invented clouds. Frame 1: a small clustered puff. Frames 2–6: it blooms into branching irregular volume. Frames 7–10: turbulent curls begin separating. Frames 11–16: soft, thin, scattered wisps progressively fade.

Layout and registration: Exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, read left-to-right, then top-to-bottom. The square atlas consists of 16 equal square cels on an invisible regular grid. Keep world scale, camera, and registration fixed. The smoke expands around the same center point in every cel. No upward drift baked into the frames; the game supplies drift. Every cel contains one complete stage of this same smoke event, with no neighboring particles intruding. Keep ALL outermost pale wisps fully inside each cel, with at least 12% of the cel width/height completely empty on EACH of its four sides. Never touch or clip the cell borders. The margins form generous truly transparent gutters. Do not draw grid lines or cel borders.

Style, color, and texture: Muted neutral gray with subtle light brown gunsmoke. Beautifully hand-painted, textured, voluminous billows with branching irregular shapes, turbulent curls, partial-alpha edges, and delicate transparent spaces between curls. Rich hand-painted 2D raster detail with crisp fine texture matching realistic pixel war-game art. Preserve fine painted detail; no smooth circles, no flat squares, no low-resolution blobs.

Transparency: Output an actual transparent raster with an alpha channel. All background, all gutters, all empty cell margins, and the empty spaces between curls are genuinely transparent. Soft smoke edges and fading wisps use partial alpha. Do not simulate transparency with a checkerboard, solid-color background, or other backdrop.

Avoid: No flame, sparks, debris, gun, scenery, floor, cast shadow, checkerboard image, text, labels, numbering, grid, border, watermark, or other objects. Exactly one atlas, exactly 16 cels, no variants.
